$comment: schema_version 1.0.0; tracks design/spec/features/NF-002-010-signed-eval-cards.md (NF-010) and ADR-0099. Additive/optional: one Score record per line of the OPTIONAL capsule file `scores.jsonl`. A capsule without scores.jsonl remains valid (SPK-EVAL-1). Planned/experimental — not yet a frozen v1 format.
title: Score
description: An evidence-grade evaluation score: a signed, replayable record binding (value, evaluator identity, subject-span digest, verdict) into a Run Capsule. Not a dashboard row.

score_id.description: ULID; time-sortable unique id for this score record.

subject.description: Content hash of the scored span or capsule (identity, not filename).

subject_kind.description: Whether `subject` addresses a single span or a whole capsule.

value.description: The score value; its Python/JSON type MUST agree with value_type.

value_type.description: boolean→value is bool; categorical→value is string; numeric→value is number.

source.description: Provenance of the score. heuristic/code run zero-token on stored capsules; judge may spend tokens on sampled subjects.

evaluator_id.description: Stable id of the evaluator that produced this score (the eval card's card_id).

eval_card_digest.description: Digest of the signed eval card that produced this score (reproducibility key).

significance.description: Optional ADR-0080 significance context for boolean/numeric scores.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the score was recorded.

run_id.description: Optional ULID of the run/capsule this score belongs to.

supersedes.description: ADR-0119 (additive, optional): score_id of a prior record this score corrects. The prior record stays in the log unchanged; a correction is a new appended record.
